query_encoder: Swift Core ML, int8-compressed weights and float16 compute; parity checked against the pinned source model before retrieval evaluation
fusion: RRF k=60 merges article and body source rankings into one lexical list; lexical and dense lists each receive one RRF vote. BM25 arm uses the same canonical passage preparation. Identical normalized final text is deduplicated within each arm before filling 20 slots.
resolver: None implemented. Reviewed-complete is an oracle control; original is unscoped and has no learned conversation resolution.
primary_metric: Manually reviewed support for the requested core answer in the admitted selected passage, not generated-answer accuracy.
controls: Original and rewritten questions retain existing Swift safety checks; orphan oracle rewrites remain unresolved. Article identity and all safety rules are unchanged.
performance: Mac build and lookup cost; no iPhone claim. Binary search uses sqlite-vec Hamming distance, full precision uses cosine distance. Binary queries are oversampled only to the same 48-candidate budget; no hidden full-vector rescoring.
comparison: Same corpus, canonical passages, model, gate and reranker budget across all arms. Existing compact-corpus results are historical context, not a controlled baseline for vector attribution.
